NEO4J.Person.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Person)
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
NEO4J.Person.loadAll.where:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
NEO4J.Person.load:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
NEO4J.Person.count:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN count(n) AS count
NEO4J.Puppy.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Puppy:Dog:Animal)
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
NEO4J.PersonCareer.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Person)
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {employmentHistory: [(n)-[r1:WORKS_FOR]->(t1:Organization) | {rel: properties(r1), target: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}}]}} AS result
NEO4J.PersonCareer.load:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {employmentHistory: [(n)-[r1:WORKS_FOR]->(t1:Organization) | {rel: properties(r1), target: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}}]}} AS result
NEO4J.PersonCareer.count:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN count(n) AS count
NEO4J.LocationHierarchy.load:
MATCH (n:Location)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {subLocations: [(n)-[r1:HAS_LOCATION]->(t1:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}, rels: {subLocations: [(t1)-[r2:HAS_LOCATION]->(t2:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t2), labels: labels(t2)}, rels: {subLocations: [(t2)-[r3:HAS_LOCATION]->(t3:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t3), labels: labels(t3)}, rels: {subLocations: []}}]}}]}}]}} AS result
NEO4J.LocationHierarchy.load.depth:
MATCH (n:Location)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {subLocations: [(n)-[r1:HAS_LOCATION]->(t1:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}, rels: {subLocations: [(t1)-[r2:HAS_LOCATION]->(t2:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t2), labels: labels(t2)}, rels: {subLocations: [(t2)-[r3:HAS_LOCATION]->(t3:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t3), labels: labels(t3)}, rels: {subLocations: [(t3)-[r4:HAS_LOCATION]->(t4:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t4), labels: labels(t4)}, rels: {subLocations: [(t4)-[r5:HAS_LOCATION]->(t5:Location) | {root: {props: properties(t5), labels: labels(t5)}, rels: {subLocations: []}}]}}]}}]}}]}}]}} AS result
NEO4J.LocationAncestors.load:
MATCH (n:Location)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {within: [x1 IN reduce(acc = [], y IN [(n)<-[:HAS_LOCATION*1..5]-(t1:Location) | t1] | CASE WHEN y IN acc THEN acc ELSE acc + y END) | {props: properties(x1), labels: labels(x1)}]}} AS result
NEO4J.ActorStats.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Actor)
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {directors: [x1 IN reduce(acc = [], y IN [(n)-[:ACTED_IN]->()-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(t1:Director) | t1] | CASE WHEN y IN acc THEN acc ELSE acc + y END) | {props: properties(x1), labels: labels(x1)}], firstDirector: head([x2 IN reduce(acc = [], y IN [z2 IN reduce(s2 = [], y2 IN [(n)-[:ACTED_IN]->(h2)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(t2:Director) | {k: h2.released, s: toString(h2.released) = h2.released, n: t2}] | [a2 IN s2 WHERE y2.k IS NULL OR (a2.k IS NOT NULL AND ((a2.s AND NOT y2.s) OR (a2.s = y2.s AND coalesce(a2.k <= y2.k, false))))] + [y2] + [a2 IN s2 WHERE NOT (y2.k IS NULL OR (a2.k IS NOT NULL AND ((a2.s AND NOT y2.s) OR (a2.s = y2.s AND coalesce(a2.k <= y2.k, false)))))]) | z2.n] | CASE WHEN y IN acc THEN acc ELSE acc + y END) | {props: properties(x2), labels: labels(x2)}]), movieCount: size([(n)-[:ACTED_IN]->(t3) | 1]), averageRating: CASE WHEN size([(n)-[:RATED]->(t4) WHERE t4.score IS NOT NULL | t4.score]) = 0 THEN null ELSE reduce(s = 0.0, v IN [(n)-[:RATED]->(t4) WHERE t4.score IS NOT NULL | t4.score] | s + v) / size([(n)-[:RATED]->(t4) WHERE t4.score IS NOT NULL | t4.score]) END, bestRating: reduce(m = null, v IN [(n)-[:RATED]->(t5) WHERE t5.score IS NOT NULL | t5.score] | CASE WHEN m IS NULL OR v > m THEN v ELSE m END)}} AS result

FALKORDB.Person.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Person)
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
FALKORDB.Person.loadAll.where:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
FALKORDB.Person.load:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
FALKORDB.Person.count:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN count(n) AS count
FALKORDB.Puppy.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Puppy:Dog:Animal)
RETURN {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)} AS result
FALKORDB.PersonCareer.load:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
CALL { WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r1:WORKS_FOR]->(t1:Organization) RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t1 IS NOT NULL THEN {rel: properties(r1), target: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}} END) AS v1 }
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {employmentHistory: v1}} AS result
FALKORDB.PersonCareer.count:
MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN count(n) AS count
FALKORDB.LocationHierarchy.load:
MATCH (n:Location)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
CALL { WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r1:HAS_LOCATION]->(t1:Location) CALL { WITH t1 OPTIONAL MATCH (t1)-[r2:HAS_LOCATION]->(t2:Location) CALL { WITH t2 OPTIONAL MATCH (t2)-[r3:HAS_LOCATION]->(t3:Location) RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t3 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t3), labels: labels(t3)}, rels: {subLocations: []}} END) AS v3 } RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t2 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t2), labels: labels(t2)}, rels: {subLocations: v3}} END) AS v2 } RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t1 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}, rels: {subLocations: v2}} END) AS v1 }
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {subLocations: v1}} AS result
FALKORDB.LocationHierarchy.load.depth:
MATCH (n:Location)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
CALL { WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r1:HAS_LOCATION]->(t1:Location) CALL { WITH t1 OPTIONAL MATCH (t1)-[r2:HAS_LOCATION]->(t2:Location) CALL { WITH t2 OPTIONAL MATCH (t2)-[r3:HAS_LOCATION]->(t3:Location) CALL { WITH t3 OPTIONAL MATCH (t3)-[r4:HAS_LOCATION]->(t4:Location) CALL { WITH t4 OPTIONAL MATCH (t4)-[r5:HAS_LOCATION]->(t5:Location) RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t5 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t5), labels: labels(t5)}, rels: {subLocations: []}} END) AS v5 } RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t4 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t4), labels: labels(t4)}, rels: {subLocations: v5}} END) AS v4 } RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t3 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t3), labels: labels(t3)}, rels: {subLocations: v4}} END) AS v3 } RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t2 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t2), labels: labels(t2)}, rels: {subLocations: v3}} END) AS v2 } RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t1 IS NOT NULL THEN {root: {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)}, rels: {subLocations: v2}} END) AS v1 }
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {subLocations: v1}} AS result
FALKORDB.LocationAncestors.load:
MATCH (n:Location)
WHERE n.uuid = $id
CALL { WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[:HAS_LOCATION*1..5]-(t1:Location) RETURN collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1 IS NOT NULL THEN {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)} END) AS v1 }
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {within: v1}} AS result
FALKORDB.ActorWithMovies.loadAll.where:
MATCH (n:Actor)
WHERE (n.name = $name) AND size([(n)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) | 1]) > 0
CALL { WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r1:ACTED_IN]->(t1:Movie) RETURN collect(CASE WHEN t1 IS NOT NULL THEN {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)} END) AS v1 }
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {movies: v1}} AS result
FALKORDB.ActorWithMovies.count:
MATCH (n:Actor)
WHERE size([(n)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) | 1]) > 0
RETURN count(n) AS count
FALKORDB.ActorWithLatestMovie.loadAll:
MATCH (n:Actor)
WHERE size([(n)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) | 1]) > 0
CALL { WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r1:ACTED_IN]->(t1:Movie) RETURN head(collect(CASE WHEN t1 IS NOT NULL THEN {props: properties(t1), labels: labels(t1)} END)) AS v1 }
RETURN {root: {props: properties(n), labels: labels(n)}, rels: {movie: v1}} AS result
